verdict.rationale: Productboard publishes a public REST API (with pagination, webhooks, configuration/schema discovery endpoints) and even an MCP server for agentic workflows, giving AI-native builders something to code against, but there is no evidence of official client SDKs (e.g., Python/JS packages) — indeed the probe for an OpenAPI spec (often used to auto-generate SDKs) returned 404s across all candidate paths. missing for 10: named official SDK libraries in specific languages, a published OpenAPI/swagger spec, and independent confirmation of SDK usage.
